Definition: adverb comparative of G4206; further, i.e. a greater distance:--farther.
BiblicalUsage: Porrhotero means further, a greater distance. Luke uses it once, on the road to Emmaus: Jesus made as though he would have gone further, and the two disciples constrained him to stay.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Christ sometimes walks on as if to leave us, not because he is leaving but because he waits to be asked to stay.
